items.source: Note that when printing a Duration, this style can be lossy if the selected unit is bigger than the resolution of the duration. For example, Duration.ofMillis(5).plusNanos(1234) would get truncated to "5ms" when printing using ChronoUnit.MILLIS.
items.translation: 请注意，当打印一个Duration时，如果所选单位大于该持续时间的分辨率，这种样式可能会导致信息丢失。例如，Duration.ofMillis(5).plusNanos(1234)在使用ChronoUnit.MILLIS打印时会被截断为"5ms"。

items.source: This is what the JDK uses in Duration.parse(CharSequence) and Duration.toString().
items.translation: 这是 JDK 在 `Duration.parse(CharSequence)`和`Duration.toString()`中使用的内容。

items.source: A single minus sign (-) is allowed to indicate the whole duration is negative. Spaces are allowed between segments, and a negative duration with spaced segments can optionally be surrounded by parentheses after the minus sign, like so: -(34m 57s).
items.translation: 允许使用单个减号 (-) 来表示整个持续时间为负。段之间可以包含空格，且带有空格的负持续时间可以在减号后可选地用括号括起来，格式如下：-(34m 57s)。

items.source: Supported unit suffixes include: ns, us, ms, s, m, h, d. Those correspond to nanoseconds, microseconds, milliseconds, seconds, minutes, hours, and days, respectively.
items.translation: 支持的单位后缀包括：ns, us, ms, s, m, h, d。它们分别对应纳秒、微秒、毫秒、秒、分钟、小时和天。

items.source: Fractional durations are not supported.
items.translation: 不支持分数持续时间。

items.source: Like SIMPLE, but allows multiple segments ordered from largest-to-smallest units of time, like 1h12m27s.
items.translation: 与 `SIMPLE` 类似，但允许按从大到小的时间单位顺序排列多个段，例如 `1h12m27s`。
